pairs.subject: agent-cli-transport
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/oembed/route.ts:6 The only file of this context that still exists in the tree is an oEmbed provider that reads a published list from Supabase and returns JSON. A case-insensitive grep of src/app/api/oembed/ for spawn, child_process, execFile, claude, anthropic and cli found nothing, and its imports (publish/oembed, publish/server) pull in only slug, Supabase and list-sync code, so no agent CLI child process is spawned here and none of the transport techniques can apply.
